subject: Observations on operational latency at Grand Inflation Industries
body:
Dear Members of the Board,

Sharp Objects Capital owns 8.2% of Grand Inflation Industries. We write ahead of Thursday's meeting to share three observations.

First, revenue has been flat for three years while your addressable categories grew 11% annually. Second, your median response time to customer and partner events, which we have measured externally, is 26 hours. Your most credible competitor for the AutoPlex renewal operates at 4. Third, this week presents a demand event of historic scale for your hero product, and we see no evidence the organization can absorb it.

We are not activists for sport. We would prefer to see management demonstrate, by Thursday, that the company can operate at the speed its market now requires. We will be watching the parade with interest, as will everyone else.

Cordially,
Nadia Pinn
Partner, Sharp Objects Capital

subject: Comment request: Swan shortage, deadline 6pm
body:
Hi, Maya Torres here, consumer desk.

Writing a piece on the Colossal Swan moment: #SwanSummer demand, reports of multi-week shipping delays, and at least one screenshot of a customer being quoted September delivery. Also seeing chatter from dealership employees about tube men shutting down mid-promotion.

Questions: 1) Can you confirm current ship times? 2) Is there a product issue with the dealership units? 3) Is the Grand Harvest Parade at risk given the helium market?

On deadline for 6pm today. A no-comment will be printed as declined to comment.

Maya
